commands.cmd:
P="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promptfoo-0.123.1"
reg=$(timeout 30 npm view promptfoo@0.123.1 dist.integrity dist.tarball --json) || { echo "PROMPTFOO_INSTALL_FAIL: npm view failed"; exit 1; }
ls=$(timeout 30 npm ls --global --prefix "$P" --depth=0 2>&1)
onpath=$(readlink -f "$(command -v promptfoo)")
python3 - "$reg" "$P" "$ls" "$onpath" <<'PY'
import base64, glob, hashlib, io, json, os, sys, tarfile, urllib.request
reg, prefix, ls, onpath = json.loads(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
pinned_integrity = 'sha512-9WzFeH6L+5E49R6CTulBo/WzmVPNcMpvgUZAyEsNlaKgpfmF9vV82jKUG1rQ+QH79P7gYAaxeY3TvLDV+x0Cbg=='
stack = [c['version'] for c in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if c['id'] == 'promptfoo']
winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'promptfoo'})
data = urllib.request.urlopen(reg['dist.tarball'], timeout=60).read()
sri = 'sha512-' + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(data).digest()).decode()
root = os.path.join(prefix, 'lib/node_modules/promptfoo')
members = [m for m in tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).getmembers() if m.isfile()]
tar = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data))
same = sum(1 for m in members if open(os.path.join(root, m.name.split('/', 1)[1]), 'rb').read() == tar.extractfile(m).read()) if os.path.isdir(root) else 0
ok = (stack == ['0.123.1'] and winners == ['0.123.1'] and reg['dist.integrity'] == pinned_integrity == sri
      and members and same == len(members) and 'promptfoo@0.123.1' in ls and onpath.startswith(root + '/'))
print('PROMPTFOO_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| stack', stack, 'winner', winners, '| registry tarball sha512 == dist.integrity == pinned integrity:', reg['dist.integrity'] == pinned_integrity == sri, '| installed files identical to the tarball:', same, 'of', len(members), '| npm ls tools/promptfoo-0.123.1:', 'promptfoo@0.123.1' in ls, '| promptfoo on PATH resolves into that prefix:', onpath.startswith(root + '/'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

      - type: contains

import hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from host_receipts import sanitize
from validate import scan_file_for_private_content
t, rc, dest, keyfile = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
raw = Path(t, 'results.json').read_text()
text = sanitize(raw.replace(t, '<tmp>'))
key = Path(keyfile).read_text().strip()

key = None
report = json.loads(text)
dest.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
sha = hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
private = scan_file_for_private_content(dest)
emails = re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', dest.read_text())
stats = report['results']['stats']
rows = report['results']['results']
outputs = [r.get('response', {}).get('output') for r in rows]
passes = [bool(r.get('success')) for r in rows]
providers = {r.get('provider', {}).get('id') for r in rows}
requests = stats.get('incurredTokenUsage', stats['tokenUsage'])['numRequests']
ok = (rc == 100 and stats['successes'] == 4 and stats['failures'] == 1 and stats['errors'] == 0 and requests == 5
      and passes == [True, True, True, True, False] and outputs == ['4', 'Paris', 'yes', 'PONG', 'PONG']
      and providers == {'openai:chat:qwen3.8-27b-local'} and key_absent and not private and not emails)
print('PROMPTFOO_EVAL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| eval exit', rc, '| successes', stats['successes'], 'failures', stats['failures'], 'errors', stats['errors'], '| retained native report', dest.as_posix(), 'sha256', sha)
print('live model requests', requests, '| outputs', outputs, '| per-row pass', passes, '| positive control caught:', passes[-1] is False, '| sanitized: key absent', key_absent, 'private-content findings', len(private), 'emails', len(emails), '| promptfoo', report.get('metadata', {}).get('promptfooVersion'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

A final read-only command shows the server's systemd unit is active, serves the model file Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf under alias qwen3.8-27b-local on the llama.cpp b11146 runtime, and answers /health.
